description: For England CQC care homes, return exact selection totals, registered providers, recorded beds, missing-value coverage and up to 25 provider summaries. Provider IDs describe registered operators, not ultimate owners. A pending response requires retrying after the supplied delay. Uses the same strict filters as query_dataset; careHome defaults to true.

filters.description: Filter object keyed by the filter keys from get_dataset_schema (not column names), e.g. {"localAuthority":"Leeds","rating":"1"}. Text filters are case-insensitive unless their schema sets caseSensitive to true; "contains" filters match substrings; enum filters must use one of the listed options.

name: get_dataset_intelligence
title: Get care-home territory intelligence
